# iphone-cli (`iph`)

> Single-binary Rust CLI and MCP server by HyunSeob that lets AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) read and operate any app on a real physical iPhone (iOS 27+) via the native accessibility tree — without Xcode, XCUITest, WebDriverAgent, code signing, or an app installed on the phone. Works on macOS and Windows over USB or Wi-Fi.

## Key Facts

- Repository: https://github.com/HyunSeob/iphone-cli
- Package (crates.io): https://crates.io/crates/iphone-cli (`cargo install iphone-cli`, binary name: `iph`)
- License: MIT
- Host OS: macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel universal binary), Windows 10/11 (x64)
- Target Device: Real physical iPhone running iOS 27 or later over USB or same LAN/Wi-Fi (does not rely on macOS iPhone Mirroring; works in the EU and on Windows)
- Out of Scope: iOS Simulators, Android, Linux hosts, landscape orientation
- Core Differentiators:
  - Reads Apple's native accessibility tree (`axAuditDaemon.remoteAXService`) as structured JSON instead of OCR/screenshots
  - Sends touch/keyboard input directly via iOS 27 CoreDevice services (`displayservice` + `universalhid`) with no Xcode or WebDriverAgent
  - Embedded QuickJS runtime (`iph script`, `iph run`) for multi-step loops, conditionals, and list extraction (`readList`) in a single agent call
  - Built-in stdio MCP server (`iph mcp`, 21 `iph_*` tools) + Claude Code / Codex Agent Skill (`skills/iph/SKILL.md`)
  - Safety-first outcome contract (`done`, `not_sent`, `unknown`) to prevent accidental double taps or duplicate submissions

## Quick Install & Agent Setup

- macOS install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HyunSeob/iphone-cli/main/install.sh | sh && iph setup`
- Cargo install: `cargo install iphone-cli`
- Claude Code MCP: `claude mcp add iph -- iph mcp`
- Codex MCP: `codex mcp add iph -- iph mcp`
